punchline: Two SEALs each said the mistake was theirs; the commander refused both and said the only one to blame was him.
thirty_sec: Before sunrise in Ramadi, a SEAL sniper fired at a silhouette entering the compound, and friendly units outside fired back at the house, each side sure the other was the enemy. One SEAL was wounded and an Iraqi soldier killed. In the debrief two men claimed the fault, but their commander, Jocko Willink, rejected both and took it himself.
question: In your last job that went wrong, what was your own share, and who have you not yet told?
key_contrast: Who is to blame? versus What went wrong?
